title: Claimy
description: A simple and lightweight chunk-based claiming plugin. Based on Worldguard.
body:
**Claimy** is a **simple and lightweight** **chunk-based** claiming plugin for Minecraft servers using **WorldGuard**.

It allows players to easily create and manage claims without complicated setup or unnecessary features.
# **Features**
- **Chunk-based** claiming system
- **Expand** claims chunk by chunk
- **Trust and untrust** players
- **Confirmation** system for dangerous actions
- **Leave** claims
- Claim **information** command

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>



```
- /claim accept                        - Accept a trust request from a player
- /claim cancel                        - Cancel dangerous actions
- /claim confirm                       - Confirm dangerous actions
- /claim create <Name>                 - Create a new claim
- /claim delete <Name>                 - Delete a claim
- /claim deny                          - Deny a trust request from a player
- /claim help                          - Get help to the _/claim_ command
- /claim expand <Name>                 - Expand an already a existing claim by one nearby chunk
- /claim info [Claim]                  - Get information for the claim you wrote, or if you write nothing, for the claim you are currently standing in
- /claim leave <Claim>                 - Leave a claim (untrust yourself)
- /claim list                          - Get a list of all claims on the server
- /claim trust <Claim> <Player>        - Send a trust request for a claim to a player
- /claim untrust <Claim> <Player>      - Untrust a player on your claim
```


</details>

# **Tested Versions**
This Plugin is only testet for **1.21.11** but it will probably work for other versions too.

# **Dependencies**
- [Worldguard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldguard) (Tested with 7.4.0)
- [Worldedit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit)   (Tested with 7.0.15)

If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please post them on my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/jV4SQ6UWn).
